cases.name: Diana Kelly
cases.about: "She was very giving, going door to door on any day giving flowers out or involved with Girls Scouts. She was easy to know and easy to love," said Gary Stubblefield, Diana’s brother
cases.narrative: On 9/26/1990, her body was found in her car in a parking lot in Joplin, MO. There were signs of hemorrhaging in her face and back, and she seemingly died from respiratory failure.Her cause of death was ruled undetermined. But after his 2nd wife was murdered they exhumed Diana's body on 8/23/1993 and the new medical examiner noted indentations and bruising around her neck, as well as damage to a throat bone, indicating she was strangled.

cases.name: Dr. Camille E. Hostetter
cases.narrative: He shot and killed her and committed suicide at her dental office. Patients and staff were present but did not hear anything in the large building. Staff found her.
